title: NextProb plugin marketplace metadata
description: Authored marketplace metadata stored as metadata.json at the root of a plugin directory. The publisher must exist in owners.json and must match the registry-derived owner of the plugin id.

publisher.description: Publisher id defined in owners.json. Must equal the owner derived from the plugin id.

license.description: SPDX license expression for the plugin, for example AGPL-3.0-or-later or MIT.

categories.description: One to three marketplace categories from the allowlist.

releaseNotes.description: Non-empty release notes for the current plugin version.

displayName.description: Optional marketplace display name when it differs from the runtime manifest name.

icon.description: Package-relative regular file containing the marketplace icon. The file must exist.

documentation.description: Package-relative documentation file. Defaults to README.md when omitted.

source.description: HTTPS URL of the plugin source repository.

deprecated.description: Marks the plugin as deprecated in the marketplace. Deprecated versions remain installable for compatibility.

withdrawn.description: Marks the plugin as withdrawn. Withdrawal is expressed in metadata; published packages and releases are never deleted or rewritten.

replacement.description: Optional plugin id suggested to users when this plugin is deprecated or withdrawn.
